description: HTML template for TinyMCE advanced image plugin with embedded JavaScript for UI interactions and form handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization function called on page load to set up the plugin UI.

methods.name: displayTab
methods.description: Function to switch between different tab panels in the UI.

methods.name: showPreviewImage
methods.description: Displays a preview of the image based on the source URL.

methods.name: changeAppearance
methods.description: Updates the appearance of the image based on user selections.

methods.name: changeHeight
methods.description: Adjusts the image height while maintaining aspect ratio if constrained.

methods.name: changeWidth
methods.description: Adjusts the image width while maintaining aspect ratio if constrained.

methods.name: styleUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to the style input field.

methods.name: changeMouseMove
methods.description: Toggles the swap image on mouse over/out events.

methods.name: insertAction
methods.description: Inserts the configured image into the editor.

methods.name: cancelAction
methods.description: Cancels the operation and closes the plugin dialog.
